prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: orthographic albedo texture-source painting for the existing Hesper ration 3D game model.
Inputs: Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, the exact orthographic model guide. Image 2 is MATERIAL AND COLOUR REFERENCE ONLY (design_reference.png); its perspective, lighting and silhouette must NOT replace the guide.
Edit image 1 in place, changing only surface colours and fine surface texture. Preserve its exact 1024 x 1024 canvas, every alpha edge, silhouette, position, scale, bevel, and part boundary. Treat its alpha mask as locked. Do not reframe, enlarge, center differently, crop or add geometry. All currently transparent pixels stay transparent. Fill every solid guide pixel with painted material, keeping every outlined part.
Subject: a rectangular block of pressed algae from the Acid Garden, wrapped in aged brown paper with natural hemp string. Match image 2: dense dark olive/mustard-green pressed algae with small flattened ochre leaf fibres and algae flakes; warm tan/brown fibrous kraft parchment with irregular pale worn fibres, subtle dark brown mottling and creased overlapping paper texture; golden tan twisted hemp twine. The pale green guide region is algae, ivory region is paper, grey/tan protruding lower region is string. Guide tints are material IDs, NOT final colours. No ceramic, metal, glass, glowing lights or invented decorations.
Render convincing detailed material colour in flat even shadowless viewer-facing illumination for an ALBEDO bake. Remove the guide and reference lighting: no cast or contact shadows, no ambient occlusion, no bright glossy flecks, no directional highlights, no shaded left/right gradient, no rim light, no reflections. All bevel faces have the same material base colour. Describe wrinkles and fibres through subtle colour detail, not deep black recesses.
Output ONE 1024 x 1024 RGBA PNG with genuinely transparent background. No background colour, floor, checkerboard drawn in pixels, text, letters, labels, border or watermark. Keep the raw output unresized.
View: exact FRONT elevation, no perspective or view of the broad top face. Follow guide_front.png. Object bounds x=66..957, y=294..729. Algae is the narrow exposed strip x=140..883, y=294..376 with fixed chamfered corners; paper is the broad horizontal body x=66..957, y=375..674. Preserve the broad shallow downward-pointing string projection x=370..653, y=675..729, filling that exact shape with hemp texture. Paint paper fold patterns and the reference twine details only inside their guide surfaces. Keep straight horizontal edges and every chamfer exactly.
reason: Initial generation; corrective regeneration will target guide alignment and flatter lighting. Returned 1254 x 1254, preserved unresized.

checks.visual_notes: Reference-like algae, paper and hemp; visible fold occlusion and shiny algae flecks. Lower guide projection became paper. Outline differs from guide.
